BoneRule.description: One bone of the skeleton the drawable carries.

name.description: The base's name for the bone, which a compile checks and never changes.

tag.description: What an animation addresses the bone by (`bone_id` of `crBoneData`); no two bones share one.

Extent.description: `spdAABB`: two corners. The fourth lane of each stays the base's.

ImportRules.description: How a glb becomes the geometry of a base, under the names the importer gives its options.

fill_missing.description:
A channel the base declares and the glb omits, such as a colour, takes a stated default
and the report names it. Off: the compile is refused.

keep_skinning.description:
A skinned drawable whose weights the glb cannot state, as a ped component's cannot
without its skeleton, keeps the ones the base holds, and is refused if the vertex count moved.

Material.description: One shader of the base, with the values it states.

flags.description: A Legacy shader's own flag words; an Enhanced one has none.

name.description: What a glb calls this material. An export names it for its shader, so two materials of one shader share a name.

parameters.description: By the name the shader database gives a parameter, else `0x` and the eight digits of its hash.

shader.description: The shader the base draws with, by name. A compile refuses a different one.

ModelRule.description: One model of the base: the name its mesh goes by in the glb, and its words.

at.description: `lod0/model0`: the level and the model in it.

name.description: What the glb calls this model's mesh, which an import pairs it by.

anyOf.description: The texture's name, which is the DDS a dictionary supplies; empty where the slot is unbound.
A constant, one row of up to four numbers per register.

Parameter.description: A parameter of a material: the name of the texture it binds, or its rows of numbers.

Real.description: A number as the shortest text that reads back as the same `f32`, so a file a person edits is not full of `0.30000001192092896`.

description: `drawable.json`: what the base holds, for a person, and the rules a compile puts the glb back by.

base.description: Written at extraction and never read by a compile, so editing it changes nothing.

bones.description: The tag of each bone of the drawable's own skeleton, in the base's order.

bucket_masks.description: The render mask of each level (`bucket_masks` of `rmcLodGroup`).

lod_distances.description: The distances the four levels of detail switch at.

materials.description:
Every shader of the base with its draw bucket, flags and parameters, in the base's order. A value
that differs from the base's is set in the compiled file, and the shader itself is refused if changed.

models.description: Each model of the base, by level, with the name its mesh goes by in the glb and its words.

skeleton.description:
The bones the drawable binds to, by name, in the order its palette indexes them. A glb that
lists its skin's bones in another order, as a modelling tool may, is bound by these names.
Left out where the base has no skeleton to name, or two of its bones share a name.

title: drawable.json
